Current node uses an unencrypted connection. Your communication may be directly viewed by network intermediate facilities controlled by authoritarian governments.
For security reasons, such nodes cannot be connected via Xray core version 26.2.6+.
If it is a self-built node, please enable security encryption such as TLS, or pin the certificate pinnedCA256.
If it is a provider node, please contact the service provider to complete the technical upgrade. If the service provider refuses to cooperate, it is recommended to switch to a provider that pays more attention to user security.

When you tap خودکار (Auto) on a subscription with no cached results yet, it real-pings the configs in that subscription and connects to one of them. Choose how that works below.
When on, Auto stops testing and connects as soon as it finds a config at or under the ping below — instead of always testing every config first. Saves time on subscriptions with many configs.
When off, Auto keeps testing every config in the subscription and connects to the single fastest one, same as before.
